en.answer: Even if your opponent adds 2 cards from their Graveyard to their hand with the effect of <<5908>>, you can activate <<10098>>. In that case, the player that activated <<5908>> chooses 1 of the 2 cards added to their hand by its effect and shuffles it into the Deck, and the effect of <<10098>> finishes resolving. (Note that the remaining card that was added to the hand remains in the opponent's hand.)
en.question: When my opponent adds 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK from their Graveyard to their hand with the effect of <<5908>>, can I activate <<10098>>?
en.title: When my opponent adds 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK from their Graveyard to their hand with the effect of <<5908>>, can I activate <<10098>>?

ja.answer:
「<<5908>>」の効果によって、相手が2枚のカードを墓地から手札に加えた時にも、「<<10098>>」を発動する事はできます。

その場合、「<<5908>>」を発動したプレイヤーが、「<<5908>>」の効果で手札に加えた2枚のカードの中から1枚を選び、デッキに戻して「<<10098>>」の効果処理を完了する事になります。
（なお、もう1枚のカードは、そのまま手札に残ります。）
